title: (RHBA-2007:0683) s390utils bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary:
Updated s390utils packages that fix several bugs and add enhancements
are now available.
portal_synopsis: s390utils bug fix and enhancement update

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.  

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use 
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
The s390utils package contains utilities related to Linux for the IBM
S/390.

These updated packages fix the following bugs:

* the dasdview manpage previously stated examples beginning with "-s" under
the "-b" option, and examples beginning with "-o" under the "-s" option.
The examples under the "-b" option should start with "-b". The examples
under the "-s" option should start with "-s". The examples have been
updated to reflect the correct usage.

* the integrated ASCII console on the Hardware Management Console (HMC) now
correctly sets the TERM environment variable to "TERM=linux".

* the manual page for the "lsdasd" command was missing. The lsdasd manual
page has been included in these updated packages.

* running ZIPL with a target directory located on a Logical Volume (LV)
caused the /root partition to become read-only, possibly leading to data
corruption. These updated packages fix ZIPL's disk-type detection logic
preventing targets from being located on LVs.

* the ZIPL bootloader did not differentiate between z/VM console (EBCDIC
037) and LPAR (EBCDIC 500) when converting EBCDIC user input. When
specifying extra kernel parameters via the boot menu on LPAR, characters
such as [, ], !, and ^ were converted incorrectly, possibly leading to
invalid kernel parameters. The EBCDIC 500 conversion table is now used on
LPAR, which resolves this issue.

This update also adds the following enhancements:

* a new userspace tool allowing Linux running on IBM System z to read
and write to tape cartridges encrypted using the IBM 3592 encryption
feature.

* a userspace daemon which adds support for monitoring Direct Access
Storage Device (DASD) utilization, using ApplData, for multiple IBM
System z/VM guests.

All s390utils users should upgrade to these updated packages, which resolve
these issues and add these enhancements.
